notes.subject: נבר
notes.rationale: Dispela tok i stap wanpela taim tasol long olgeta Tanakh; ol man i tingting em i kam long ברר — 'klia'

notes.subject: תתפל
notes.rationale: פתל em i 'twine/kunekune': KJV 'unsavoury', YLT 'a wrestler', JPS 'subtle' — Tok Pisin i holim piksa bilong kunekune

notes.subject: נבר/תתבר · עקש/תתפל
notes.rationale: Wankain ritim klostu olsem ves 26 — pasin i go daun wantaim man

translation: Wantaim man klia, yu save soim pasin klia; na wantaim man i senisim rot, yu save wokim pasin i kunekune.

tokens.gloss: yu save wokim pasin i kunekune
